issue_request: FHIR-13072 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested the ability to search Questionnaire by definition, specifically to find questionnaires whose items reference a particular data element URI such as `/Questionnaire?definition={{data element uri}}`.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 12848, and git-svn commit 9e5e6b6148200ba40e05540d1e6f4aefcca3f6e5 has a #13072/#13073 title, but the actual Questionnaire spreadsheet search rows appear in nearby commit 6f2064cca165eecaa28d2c0775ef47d5de87c1c7, which added `definition` as a uri search parameter over `Questionnaire.item.definition`. The 2021 source rework preserved that as `source/questionnaire/bundle-Questionnaire-search-params.xml`.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The current search-parameter bundle has `Questionnaire-definition` with code `definition`, type `uri`, and expression `Questionnaire.repeat(item).definition`; later FHIR-49784 recursive-search work intentionally broadened nested Questionnaire search expressions to use `repeat`. FHIR-13073 is the adjacent same-change-family issue for `subject-type` and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: The combined branch already contains the empty audit commit fe05561f8ba9a057bb868b349e06c96b88d558a8 for FHIR-13072. No duplicate commit was published, and no source edits were made.
